title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Repeat-Placement Load on Commercial Placements
content:
**Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Lender-Placed Flood – Commercial Building tier.** Repeat-placement load for a commercial placement: the rated amount of a commercial placement is multiplied by 1.10 when two or more certificates were issued earlier under the program on the same loan number, by 1.05 when exactly one was, and by 1.00 when none was.

| Certificates issued earlier under the program on the loan number being placed | Multiplier on the rated amount |
|---|---|
| None | 1.00 |
| Exactly one | 1.05 |
| Two or more | 1.10 |

The count is of issue entries carrying the same loan number under the program, including certificates that have since expired or been cancelled; renewal entries are not issue entries.
